Topics covered in this PDF

BHIE-145 (Some Aspects of European History 1789-1945) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Factors behind revolutionary change in France, industrialisation in France and Germany, early socialist thinkers, the Metternich system, liberal democracies and nationalism
  • New Economic Policy, the economic crisis, the terror and the purges, colonialism, the beginning of the Cold War

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three assignments, answer all questions, marks 100, assignment code BHIE-145/ASST/TMA/2026-27. Assignment I: two questions of 20 marks (about 500 words each). Assignment II: three questions of 10 marks (about 250 words each). Assignment III: five questions of 6 marks (about 100 words each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
